sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Tactile), Wind Release

system.description:
You unleash a rotating force of wind that drags everything to its center. Select a point you can see within range as you create a vortex of suction, forcing each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on the chosen point, must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, creatures and objects take 5d6 wind damage and are pulled 10-feet closer to the point and fall Prone or half as much damage and no additional effects on a successful save. Structures and objects treat damage from this jutsu as if they are vulnerable to it.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 5d6 wind damage.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 5d6 wind damage and are Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures take 5d6 wind damage and gain 1 rank of Dazzled. Structures and objects treat damage from this jutsu as if they are vulnerable to it.

Critical Failure: Same as Failure, but affected creature takes 7d6 wind damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6 and radius by 5 feet.
